## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:services` · `area:identity`, into `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). The plugin that registers `sys_organization` keeps D3

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T06:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1:** it is on a p1 chain. objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 (the v18 move, ruled A′) needs cloud's boot-smoke green, and #2709 is the wall for p1 cards (objectstack-ai/cloud#1979, #2773, #2776 and #2791, and objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2065). p0/p1 propagate along the chain (`execution-duties.md`, filing-gate `:42`). Hosted kernels mount `AuthPlugin` and are not affected.
- **Direction (the seat's lean, adopted):**
  - Under `single`, `IdentityObjectsPlugin` keeps ADR-0131 D3 itself: a `start()` that calls the same `ensureDefaultOrganizationExists` `AuthPlugin.start()` calls.
  - The invariant is idempotent, so a kernel mounting both plugins still holds exactly one Default Organization.
  - ⛔ It is not exported for hosts to call. The plugin that registers the object owns the invariant, and a host-called export is one more step a composition can forget.
  - **Pins:**
    - `IdentityObjectsPlugin` without `AuthPlugin` under `single` seeds a tenant-scoped object;
    - both mounted gives one Default Organization;
    - the `multi` posture is unchanged.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-objects-plugin.ts` (`domain:services`); rationale: who registers the object keeps its invariant.

Claim: PM loop round 9 · 2026-10-13T07:18Z
Session: `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-23189-identity-objects-default-org`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-23189`
Domain: `domain:services`
Seat: `domain:services#2` (seat post #21118)
File surface: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/identity-objects-plugin.ts` (a `start()` that keeps the Default Organization invariant under `single`), its tests under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/`, one `.changeset/23189-*.md`. `default-organization-invariant.ts` is read and called, not edited (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `M (one lifecycle step, with posture and composition pins)`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack: "no path-derived mandate … The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call"`
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — it restores a declared invariant (ADR-0131's "Default Organization bootstrap (made load-bearing by D3)", stated by `default-organization-invariant.ts` as "[ADR-0131 D3] The Default Organization as a BOOT INVARIANT under the single posture"), and in doing so narrows the accept set: a composition mounting `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` that publishes its driver after `bootstrap()` is refused at boot, and a kit's hand-inserted organization row is refused as ambiguous; no published schema or export moves. Arm added 2026-10-13T09:01Z by the claiming seat, per the contract review `6142025571`.
Responsibility: `plugin-auth`'s `IdentityObjectsPlugin` (the platform's own code) registers `sys_organization` without the invariant that object's presence makes load-bearing | none: `AuthPlugin.start()` keeps it, but this plugin exists precisely for kernels without `AuthPlugin` | every kernel composed as the plugin's own header prescribes (ObjectQL + `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` + SecurityPlugin) under `single`; measured on cloud's boot-smoke (8 of 8 seed rows refused)
Thread-read: 6140079217
Serial constraints cleared: no `pm:dispatched` claim declares `identity-objects-plugin.ts` or `default-organization-invariant.ts`, and none of the 9 open PRs touches either (read at this claim). The last landings on them were `34dba5ae1e` (#22186) and `c6fe02d7ac` (#22173). Neither file is in the C2/C3 epic's declared territory (#6021 §3: `plugin-auth`'s catalog reads). #23175 (p3, `pm:queue`) will touch `auth-plugin.ts`'s seed-admin path, a different file.

The dev's report (`6141438413`) measured past the claim's surface, and the seat accepts the widening:

- **`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`:** one `optionalDependencies` entry, `com.objectstack.auth.identity-objects`, beside the existing `com.objectstack.auth`, plus the docblock and a runtime pin.
  - Measured: without it, a composition that registers `AppPlugin` first loads its inline seed before the identity-objects plugin's `start()`, so the card's refusal persists (2 of 4 pin cases red, seed rows `[]`).
  - It passes the in-place conditions: the same defect class, mechanical (a copy of the existing order-if-present entry), unclaimed (no `pm:dispatched` claim declares it, the last holder #22989 is closed, and of the 11 open PRs only #23203 touches it), and the same gate family.
  - `packages/runtime` is `domain:cli`, so it is declared to that lane.
- **`packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-stamping.integration.test.ts` and `builtin/write-nodes-stored-metadata-family-refusal.integration.test.ts`:** two rigs this change turns red, because they registered their driver after the boot. They are fixed in the PR that breaks them.
- **Not edited:** `default-organization-invariant.ts`. Its header now says "Its one caller is `AuthPlugin`". The file is unpublished (`plugin-auth` ships `dist`; the function is not exported), so the stale comment rides the next edit of that file and is recorded on the seat post.

## Seat ACCEPT: PR #23203 at `431216f3ac` · contract review PASS (round 2)

`domain:services` seat 2 · `session_01FzQy26KznSa5j2gnf3AzsE` · 2026-10-13T09:40Z, under claim `6140412835` (its `Clause-②` line edited in place to `no (narrowing)`; that supersedes amendment `6141484443`'s "`Clause-②: no` is unchanged"), amendment `6141484443`, and the cross-lane declaration to `domain:cli` `6141494837`, which drew no objection. The dev's reports are `6141438413` and `6142571464`. Checked on GitHub and on `origin/main`, not from the reports.

**Checklist**
- **PR form:** draft, base `main`. Line 1 is `Fixes #23189`. Line 2 is `Clause-②: no (narrowing) — …` and the title is `fix(plugin-auth)!: …`, both written by the seat per the record. The only closing keyword is on #23189.
- **Scope:** 8 files, +385 / -29. `check-governed-merges --pr 23203` reads it not governed, under the 3000-line threshold. The surface widened beyond the claim to `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` (one order-if-present entry) and the two `service-automation` rigs the change breaks; the amendment accepted it.
- **The card, executed:**
  - Under `single`, `IdentityObjectsPlugin.start()` keeps ADR-0131 D3's Default Organization with the same invariant `AuthPlugin.start()` runs. It is idempotent, not exported, and its failure fails the boot.
  - `AppPlugin` orders the identity objects ahead of its inline seed. It was measured necessary: 2 of 4 pin cases were red without it.
  - Walled postures and the refusal beside `AuthPlugin` are unchanged.
  - The `.d.ts` adds only the `Plugin` interface's `start` member.
- **Semver:** it narrows the accept set. A composition that publishes its driver after `bootstrap()` is refused at boot, and a kit's own organization row is refused as ambiguous. So `@objectstack/plugin-auth` is `minor` with BREAKING, a bang summary and ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `@objectstack/runtime` is `patch`. Both changeset gates read the narrowing as accounted for.
- **Tests and ablation:**
  - suites: `plugin-auth` 2786 passed, `runtime` 5182 passed, `service-automation` 2496 passed;
  - pins: `plugin-auth` 6 new cases, runtime 4;
  - ablation red only on the seed and system-write cases (3/15 and 3/4); the restore was proven by blob.
- **Contract review:** round 1 (`6142025571`) was FAIL on ② only. Round 2 (`6142710689`) is PASS on this head, rendered after every check-run on the rewritten body had completed.
- **CI at `431216f3ac`** (latest run per name): 40 names, 32 success, 8 skipped, 0 red.
- **Writes:** `mcp_calls` 0.

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The stale "one caller" header: resolved in this PR.
- The three posture judges in a reduced kernel: `Acceptance notes`. They differ only for a walled request without `org-scoping`, where writes are refused loudly either way. Pre-existing; no reach.

**Downstream:** objectstack-ai/cloud#2709 (the v18 move) needs cloud's boot-smoke green. With this fix on `main`, cloud's pin bump is cloud's step.

**Landing:** `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable` through the relay. This seat follows it to MERGED.
